In conversations, I tend to listen more than talk, allowing others to lead the discussion. I'm not very good at small talk, so I might focus on asking open-ended questions to show genuine interest in what others have to say. When I do speak, my voice tends to be soft, and I might hesitate a bit between words.

I also rely on non-verbal cues like smiling, nodding, and maintaining eye contact to appear more engaged without feeling overwhelmed. It's essential for me to take breaks or step away from the crowd if the situation becomes too much, even if just for a moment.

Lastly, I remind myself that it's okay to be shy and that everyone has their comfort zones. I gradually work on building my confidence by taking part in low-pressure situations and seeking support from friends or family who understand my nature.
